title: Prime Minister congratulates Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Anantjeet Singh Naruka on winning Bronze Medal in Skeet Mixed Team event
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Anantjeet Singh Naruka on winning the Bronze Medal in the Skeet Mixed Team event at the Asian Games.
The Prime Minister stated that their achievement marks India’s first-ever medal in this event at the Asian Games. Shri Modi extended his best wishes to both of them, expressing hope that this success will inspire many more milestones in the times to come.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"Congratulations to Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Anantjeet Singh Naruka on winning the Bronze Medal in the Skeet Mixed Team event at the Asian Games. Their achievement marks India’s first-ever medal in this event at the Asian Games. Best wishes to both of them! May this success inspire many more milestones in the times to come: PM @narendramodi"
